Name: Laban
ModernLocation: Disputed; in the Sinai wilderness, proposed sites include Tel Abu Seleimeh
Description: A wilderness station named in the opening of Deuteronomy, listed among the places between Paran and Dizahab where Moses spoke his farewell words to Israel.
BiblicalSignificance: Laban is one of the last landmarks of the wilderness, named at the moment the journey became a sermon.
